name: Astrid Karlsson
bio:
Astrid's journey in motorsport started unexpectedly. Growing up in a small town in Sweden, she was more interested in dismantling and rebuilding old engines than following racing. A local rally team noticed her knack for problem-solving and offered her a junior mechanic position. She quickly excelled, absorbing knowledge and earning respect through her meticulous work and unwavering dedication.

Over the years, Astrid honed her skills, moving from mechanics to data analysis and eventually engineering. She's known for her calm demeanor under pressure and her ability to dissect complex problems into manageable components. Her approach to engineering is rooted in practicality and a relentless pursuit of efficiency. While she appreciates innovative ideas, she prioritizes reliability and performance above all else. What sets her apart is her deep understanding of the intricate relationship between driver feedback and car setup, making her a valuable asset in optimizing performance.

Now at MP Motorsport Junior, Astrid is looking to pass on her experience to the next generation of engineers, fostering a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement within the team. She values honest communication and always encourages her team members to challenge conventional thinking.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly styled bob with a slight wave
physical.description: Astrid is a woman of medium height with a focused gaze and a no-nonsense presence.

quirks: Always carries a small multi-tool in her pocket
Prefers to communicate through detailed diagrams and flowcharts
Has a peculiar habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deep in thought
